title: 有馬記念の後に・吹き続け、どこまでも

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner of the Arima Kinen is Yamanin Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Does the true wind know no boundaries?! Against all odds, Yamanin Zephyr has become a quadruple-distance champion!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's just so frustrating. No matter how fast I run, I can't catch up to you…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You really are like the wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Hehe, I'm honored to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That wasn't even a compliment! I'm complaining! Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But sorry, 'cause even after racing a wind like that…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not ready to call it quits. So let's race again sometime, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And when we do, I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll race you whenever you like, and as many times as you like.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: After all, the wind never stops blowing.
